shared_elements: repeated animals arranged in a row/procession
incised linear surface texture (rows of short strokes)
justification: Both are stone low reliefs featuring profile quadrupeds set side by side in a row, with areas of repetitive incised linear texture, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a large-scale, highly finished and volumetric pair of horned heads filling the field with meticulous curling detail, while B is a shallow, schematic, small-figured composition divided into stacked registers with a patterned band, discs and a bird, on a rough weathered upright block.
